{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify the entire dataset is the campaign data
# The data dictionary states this is a Q3 e-commerce campaign test export
# Therefore, the population 'all sales records' is the campaign

# Check the total sales (revenue) to assess campaign performance
print("Total revenue:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].sum())

# Check the number of converted orders
print("Number of converted orders:")
print(sales_df['converted'].sum())

# Check the conversion rate across the entire dataset
print("Overall conversion rate:")
print(sales_df['converted'].mean())

# Check the distribution of revenue
print("Revenue distribution (summary):")
print(sales_df['revenue'].describe())

# Check if there are any records with zero revenue but converted
print("Records with zero revenue but converted:")
print(sales_df[(sales_df['revenue'] == 0) & (sales_df['converted'] == 1)].shape[0])"}
